changes.title: Fix the integrations list on core 2026.11.2; keep a sign-in out of backups [skip ci]
changes.detail:
The Python suites finally ran, and earned their keep at once. The new "export the list" command asked the device registry for devices in a way core 2026.11.2 now refuses, so the command failed whenever counts were on, which is the default. It now walks the devices and reads each one's single config entry. Its tests were also brought in line with current core: a mock integration needs a registered config flow, and setup and unload return nothing rather than a boolean.

The problem log's stored sign-in is now left out of backups, next to its wording store. After a restore, the owner signs in again.

Results: core suites for today's changes all pass (pointers 38, export and import 59, automatic updates 130, hassio 149, problem log 77, registry storage 246, recordings 210, linked media 63, config entries 74, config validation 233). Backup 632 passed with one failure in a test whose own layout cannot pass; bootstrap has 20 to 24 failures that are the same without today's changes. Supervisor: 763 passed, none failed. The problem log tests ran before its latest change, so the newest websocket tests there are still unrun.
changes.detail_yue:
修好整合清單喺 core 2026.11.2 嘅問題；登入資料唔入備份。

Python 測試終於行到，一行就即刻有貢獻。新嘅「匯出清單」指令問裝置 登記冊攞裝置嘅方法，core 2026.11.2 已經唔准用，所以只要開咗數量 （預設係開）指令就會失敗。而家改為逐部裝置行一次，讀返每部裝置 唯一嘅設定項目。測試亦跟返現時嘅 core：模擬整合要有登記咗嘅設定 流程，設定同卸載要回傳空值而唔係布林值。

問題記錄儲存嘅登入資料而家同用字儲存一樣唔入備份；還原之後擁有人 要再登入一次。

結果：今日改動相關嘅 core 測試全部通過（指標 38、匯出匯入 59、 自動更新 130、hassio 149、問題記錄 77、登記處儲存 246、錄影 210、 連結媒體 63、設定項目 74、設定驗證 233）。備份 632 個通過，一個 失敗係測試本身嘅佈局冇可能過；bootstrap 有 20 至 24 個失敗，冇咗 今日嘅改動都係一樣。Supervisor：763 個通過，冇失敗。問題記錄嘅 測試係喺佢最新改動之前行嘅，所以嗰度最新嘅 websocket 測試仲未行。

changes.title: Problem log: choose or create the repository, wording, and a hiding repair [skip ci]
changes.detail:
Built from the board, after reading a real sent log.

Where to send: after signing in, the page lists the owner's repositories in a searchable list. Private ones can be chosen; public ones are shown as unusable and are refused by the server as well. A new private repository can be made behind the two keys, and is read back to be private before it is used. A repository that already holds other files gets the log in its own folder.

Sign-in: no client ID is built in. The setting now explains what one is and where to get it, and the page repeats that GitHub names the app that asks.

Wording: an owner switch, off by default, lets the owner's own wording file be used in the log's own headings and labels. Log lines, logger names, code and anything in a fenced block stay exact. The stored copy is private, left out of backups, and deleted when the switch goes off.

Hiding repair: the step that hides names given to things was matching them anywhere, so a thing named like the product rewrote every logger name and a thing named "sun" rewrote an integration. Program text is now set aside before hiding and put back after. In the other direction, entity ids inside condition dumps were only hidde
changes.detail_yue:
問題記錄：揀或者開儲存庫、用字，同埋修好遮名。照設計板起，仲睇過 一份真正傳送咗嘅記錄。

傳去邊：登入之後，頁面會用有搜尋嘅清單列出擁有人嘅儲存庫。私人 嘅可以揀；公開嘅會顯示為用唔到，伺服器亦一樣拒絕。可以過兩條鑰匙 開一個新嘅私人儲存庫，開完會讀返確認係私人先用。本身有其他檔案 嘅儲存庫，記錄會放喺自己個資料夾。

登入：冇內置任何 client ID。設定而家會解釋佢係乜、喺邊度攞，頁面 亦會再講一次：GitHub 會講明係邊個應用程式要求授權。

用字：擁有人開關，預設關閉，開咗之後記錄自己嘅標題同標籤會用 擁有人嘅用字檔案。記錄行、logger 名、程式碼同圍欄入面嘅嘢一律 原封不動。儲存嘅副本係私人嘅，唔入備份，熄咗開關就刪除。

修好遮名：之前遮「幫嘢改嘅名」係喺任何位置都配對，所以一樣同產品 同名嘅嘢改寫晒所有 logger 名，一樣叫「sun」嘅嘢改寫咗一個整合。 而家會先將程式文字抽起，遮完再放返。另一邊，條件內容入面嘅實體 ID 之前只會遮仲存在嘅實體；而家所有實體 ID 都會換成標籤。

檢查：純模組測試架 94 個個案全過；前端型別得返兩個已知錯誤；前端 測試 9694 個通過，三個已知失敗。websocket 測試冇行到，冇向真正 服務發過請求，亦未喺瀏覽器睇過。

changes.title: Design board: problem log sign-in, choosing a repository, wording [skip ci]
changes.detail:
The problem log board grows a column, drawn before the code. After signing in with a code, the owner picks a private repository from a searchable list, or has a new private one made behind the two keys. Public repositories are shown as unusable rather than offered, and privacy is checked again before every send.

Two more rules joined the list. The owner's own wording file can be used in what is sent, only when the owner turns that on, and it never lands in the repository as a list. And hiding names must stop rewriting the names of programs: a log where the product's own module name has been swapped for a label is a crossword, not a log.
changes.detail_yue:
設計板：問題記錄嘅登入、揀儲存庫同用字。未寫程式先畫板，問題記錄 塊板多咗一欄。用代碼登入之後，擁有人可以喺有搜尋嘅清單揀一個 私人儲存庫，或者過兩條鑰匙之後開一個新嘅私人儲存庫。公開嘅 儲存庫會顯示為用唔到，唔會畀你揀；每次傳送之前都會再查一次係咪 私人。

規則多咗兩條。擁有人自己嘅用字檔案可以用喺傳送嘅內容度，但要 擁有人開咗先用，亦唔會以清單形式放入儲存庫。另外，遮名唔可以再 改寫程式嘅名：連產品自己個模組名都換成標籤嘅記錄，係填字遊戲， 唔係記錄。

changes.title: Export and import for integrations: the list, and each one's settings [skip ci]
changes.detail:
Built from the board. The Integrations page can now write a packing list of what is installed and what kinds of entity each integration makes, and read such a list back to show what is missing here. The list carries no sign-in, setting, address or state. Importing only compares; "Set up" opens each integration's own setup, one at a time, and a row counts as here only once an entry really exists. A file that is too big, the wrong kind or the wrong shape is refused whole, and every name in it is treated as text.

Each integration can also export and import its own settings. Sign-ins are left out by default, by a deliberately suspicious filter: when in doubt, it is a sign-in. Asking for them needs the two keys and a strong password, and the file is then always encrypted with the project's existing primitives; no new cryptography was written. An import fits only the integration and entry version it names, shows every change by name first, applies after the two keys, keeps the earlier settings for Undo, and puts them back by itself if the integration refuses to load. It never creates an entry.

Said plainly in the documentation: for a locked file the password does travel over the signed
changes.detail_yue:
整合嘅匯出同匯入：成張清單，同埋每個整合自己嘅設定。照設計板起。

整合頁而家可以寫一張執行李清單：裝咗啲乜、每個整合會整出邊類 實體；亦可以讀返呢張清單，話你知呢度爭咗邊啲。清單入面冇登入 資料、設定、地址或者狀態。匯入只係比較；「設定」會逐個打開嗰個 整合自己嘅設定流程，要真係有咗先當係「已經喺度」。檔案太大、 種類唔啱或者格式唔啱，成個拒絕；入面每個名都只當文字處理。

每個整合亦可以匯出同匯入自己嘅設定。登入資料預設唔放，個過濾器 刻意多疑：唔肯定就當係登入資料。要放嘅話，要過兩條鑰匙加一個夠 強嘅密碼，檔案一定用項目現有嘅加密元件加密，冇寫新嘅密碼學。 匯入只啱返佢寫明嗰個整合同版本，會先逐項列出改動嘅名稱，過咗 兩條鑰匙先套用，之前嘅設定會留低畀你還原；整合載入唔到嘅話會 自己還原。永遠唔會新增項目。

文件照直講：鎖住嘅檔案，密碼喺嗰一次呼叫會經已登入嘅連線傳送； 唔會儲存、唔會寫入記錄、唔會傳返出嚟。

檢查：前端型別得返兩個已知錯誤；前端測試 9689 個通過，三個已知 失敗；登入資料過濾器 35 個個案全過。伺服器嘅 websocket 測試冇行到 （今日冇容器引擎），亦未喺瀏覽器睇過。

changes.title: Checking for updates no longer installs the Supervisor [skip ci]
changes.detail:
Reported by the owner: with automatic updates switched off, pressing "Check for updates" installed an update anyway. The Supervisor has a self-update setting of its own, on by default, that fires after every refresh of the version list, at its own start, on its daily reload and when the channel changes. The switches on the Updates page never touched it, so "off" was more of a suggestion.

Now there is one installer per part. The Supervisor's own setting defaults to off, and Core turns it off on existing installs at every refresh; if that cannot be confirmed, the check skips asking the Supervisor to reload, so looking cannot install. The Supervisor is installed only by a press of Update, or by the owner's own switch inside its window with its waiting days and backup choice. The page shows a warning with "Turn off now" if the Supervisor still reports its own setting as on.

Side effects, on purpose: Supervisor plugins no longer update on a schedule; they update as part of an install someone started, and the repair of a missing plugin at start is unchanged. Restoring a backup from a newer Supervisor now asks for the Supervisor to be updated first instead of doing it silently.

Core an
changes.detail_yue:
檢查更新唔再會順手裝埋 Supervisor。

擁有人報告：自動更新熄咗，撳「檢查更新」竟然照裝。原來 Supervisor 自己有個自我更新設定，預設係開，每次重新整理版本清單、自己啟動、 每日重新載入、轉頻道之後都會發動。更新頁嗰啲開關從來冇掂過佢， 所以「熄咗」只係一個建議。

而家每個部分只有一個安裝途徑。Supervisor 自己個設定預設關閉， 舊有安裝會由 Core 每次重新整理嗰陣熄咗佢；如果確認唔到，檢查就 唔會叫 Supervisor 重新載入，所以睇一睇唔會變成裝。Supervisor 只會喺有人撳「更新」，或者擁有人自己開咗開關、喺指定時段、過咗 等候日數同備份選擇之後先會裝。如果 Supervisor 仲話自己個設定係 開，頁面會出警告同「即刻閂咗佢」。

刻意嘅副作用：Supervisor 插件唔再定時自己更新，而係跟住有人發起 嘅安裝一齊更新；啟動時修復唔見咗嘅插件就照舊。還原由較新 Supervisor 做嘅備份，而家會叫你先更新 Supervisor，唔再靜靜雞自己做。

Core 同作業系統嘅途徑都查過，確認受各自開關管住；新測試證明開關 熄咗嗰陣檢查唔會裝任何嘢。檢查：前端型別得返兩個已知錯誤；前端 測試 9665 個通過，三個已知失敗。Python 測試冇行到（今日冇容器 引擎），亦未喺瀏覽器睇過。

changes.title: Design board: export and import for integrations [skip ci]
changes.detail:
A board drawn before any code. The Integrations page gets a packing list: export what is installed and what kinds of entity each one makes, and import such a list to see what is missing and set it up one at a time. The list carries no sign-in, no setting and no state, and importing installs nothing by itself.

Each integration can also pack its own settings. Sign-ins stay out of the suitcase unless the owner asks, and then the suitcase is always locked with the owner's password behind the two keys. An import shows every change by name first, applies only after the two keys and the slider, and keeps the earlier settings so Undo works.
changes.detail_yue:
設計板：整合嘅匯出同匯入，未寫程式先畫板。整合頁多咗一張執行李 清單：匯出裝咗啲乜、每個整合會整出邊類實體；匯入呢張清單就睇到 爭咗邊啲，再逐個設定。清單入面冇登入資料、冇設定、冇狀態，匯入 本身唔會自己裝任何嘢。

每個整合亦可以將自己嘅設定執入喼。登入資料預設唔放入去，除非 擁有人要求；要放嘅話，個喼一定用擁有人嘅密碼鎖住，仲要過兩條 鑰匙。匯入會先逐項列出改動嘅名稱，過咗兩條鑰匙同滑桿先至套用， 之前嘅設定會留低，方便還原。
